strings.Install Rectangle via Homebrew cask: 透過 Homebrew cask 安裝 Rectangle
strings.Window manager for macOS to move and res: macOS 視窗管理工具，可透過快捷鍵與吸附區域移動及調整視窗大小。
strings.brew install --cask --appdir=$HOME/Appli: brew install --cask --appdir=$HOME/Applications rectangle，無需管理員權限即可安裝
strings.cycle stacked windows in same area: 在同一區域循環切換堆疊視窗
strings.move and resize windows with keyboard sh: 以鍵盤快捷鍵移動與調整視窗大小
strings.snap windows by dragging to screen edges: 將視窗拖曳至螢幕邊緣自動吸附
strings.tile windows in rows or columns: 以多欄或多列平鋪視窗
